user.title: Add a heat pump
user.description: Assign your sensors to roles. Only the electrical power is required; every extra sensor unlocks more analyses. Nothing is controlled – the tools only read history.

data_description.power_entity: Power drawn by the heat pump (sub-meter or vendor sensor). Used to detect compressor runs.
data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Unlocks cycling vs. weather, energy signature and heating curve.
data_description.flow_temp_entity: Supply water temperature. Unlocks heating curve analysis.
data_description.heat_energy_entity: Thermal energy meter. Unlocks real COP and seasonal performance factor.
data_description.circuit_flow_temp_entity: Flow temperature of the heating circuit, i.e. what the heating curve controls (after a buffer or mixer). Unlocks the heating curve analysis.
data_description.circuit_flow_target_entity: The flow temperature the controller calculates from its heating curve. Gives the cleanest curve and shows whether it is delivered.
data_description.curve_slope_entity: The slope setting of your controller, reported for reference.
data_description.room_entities: Climate entities of the rooms (any brand). Unlocks room comfort: overheated rooms and the room that limits the curve.
data_description.valve_entities: Entities showing whether a circuit's valve or actuator is open: switch, binary sensor or actuator power. Matched to rooms automatically.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already used by another heat pump.
